channels.name: MOSI
channels.purpose: Master-Output Slave-Input serial data; in bidirectional master mode acts as MOMI (Master I/O); in bidirectional slave mode is not used by SPI.

channels.name: MISO
channels.purpose: Master-Input Slave-Output serial data; in bidirectional master mode is not used; in bidirectional slave mode acts as SISO (Slave I/O).
channels.active_levels: Push-pull CMOS (slave output); high-impedance when slave deselected

channels.name: SCK
channels.purpose: Serial clock; 16 edges per 8-bit transfer; idle polarity per CPOL.

channels.name: SS
channels.direction_master: output (when MODFEN=1 + SSOE=1) or input (mode-fault detection when MODFEN=1 + SSOE=0) or unused (MODFEN=0)
channels.purpose: Slave-Select; LOW = selected; HIGH = deselected (slave output tri-stated and SCK input ignored).

global_signals.name: BusClock
global_signals.purpose: MCU bus clock; source for baud-rate generator.

global_signals.name: Reset
global_signals.purpose: MCU system reset; resets all SPI registers.

ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: TX and RX are simultaneous on the same 16-SCK-edge transfer (full duplex).

dependency_graph.common_rule: Master drives SCK + (optionally) SS. Slave drives MISO (or MOMI/SISO under bidirectional gating). Slave samples on the CPHA-defined edge; master samples on the same CPHA-defined edge.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: MOSI/MISO data is sampled on the latching edge defined by {CPOL, CPHA} pair.

handshake_pairs.name: BUS_WRITE_SPIDR
handshake_pairs.rule: SPTEF=1 → write to SPIDR queued for next transmission.

handshake_pairs.name: RX_SHIFT_TO_SPIDR
handshake_pairs.rule: After last sample edge, RX byte copied to SPIDR + SPIF=1.
